verifier_findings: The train.py patch implements one bounded architecture change: three zero-initialized FP32 per-channel skip gates at depth 6, pairing encoder outputs 2, 1, 0 with decoder inputs 3, 4, 5. Existing block calls and norm/dtype policies are unchanged.

New gates consume no initialization RNG and are explicitly registered exactly once in gate_params, receiving AdamW at MATRIX_LR with betas (0.9, 0.95) and zero weight decay—not Muon or the scalar group.

The toggle and gate tensors are checkpointed; load_for_eval restores the saved toggle before constructing GPT and strictly loading candidate weights. Skip additions are position-wise and preserve structural causality.

No data, tokenizer, evaluation procedure, budget, distributed execution, seed-42 default, or external-data/pretrained initialization behavior is changed. Supplied deterministic checks pass; runtime correctness and performance remain subsequent controller gates.
